svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Band: steel strip 40 x 3 mm, about 760 long, rolled to 340 ID;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: woven brake lining 5 mm riveted inside with countersunk rivets.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The band wraps about 245 deg round the brake rim on the left flange,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ends: a 10 mm link from each end. The upper end goes to the pivot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pin; the lower end goes to the inner arm, 50 mm from the pivot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pivot: 20 mm shaft through a 21 mm hole in the left cheek, 200

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: behind and 330 above the ground. Inner arm inside, lever outside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lever: 25 mm bar, 450 long, rising at 62 deg toward the rear; grip

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at the top. Lifting the lever tightens the band.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 92 N pull on the grip holds the rated 3 kN rope pull (estimate).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lining 2 to 3 mm off the rim when the lever is down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lever up, the drum cannot be turned by hand at the rim.
